name: litmus-mcp
description: Natural-language access to Litmus Edge industrial IoT: device management, NATS topics, InfluxDB history, digital twins, and marketplace containers.

edge_url.title: Litmus Edge URL
edge_url.description: Base URL of your Litmus Edge instance (e.g. https://edge.example.com)

edge_client_id.title: Edge API Client ID
edge_client_id.description: OAuth client ID from your Litmus Edge admin console

edge_client_secret.title: Edge API Client Secret
edge_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret from your Litmus Edge admin console

validate_certificate.title: Validate TLS certificate
validate_certificate.description: Set true for production Edges with valid certs; false for self-signed (default)

edge_manager_url.title: LEM URL (optional)
edge_manager_url.description: Litmus Edge Manager URL. Required only for LEM tools.

edge_api_token.title: LEM API token (optional)
edge_api_token.description: Required for LEM tools and LEM-bridge auth

edge_manager_project_id.title: LEM project ID (optional)
edge_manager_project_id.description: Default LEM project. Can be overridden per tool call.

edge_manager_device_id.title: LEM device ID (optional)
edge_manager_device_id.description: Required only for LEM-bridge mode (proxy through LEM to a specific Edge)

edge_manager_admin_url.title: LEM admin URL (optional)
edge_manager_admin_url.description: Defaults to LEM URL host on port 8446 if blank

nats_source.title: NATS host
nats_source.description: Hostname or IP of the NATS broker on your Edge

nats_port.title: NATS port
nats_port.description: TCP port the NATS broker listens on

nats_user.title: NATS username (optional)
nats_user.description: Username for NATS authentication. Leave blank for token or anonymous auth.

nats_password.title: NATS password (optional)
nats_password.description: Password matching the NATS username above.

nats_token.title: NATS token (optional)
nats_token.description: Token-based NATS authentication. Alternative to username/password.

nats_tls.title: NATS use TLS
nats_tls.description: Use TLS when connecting to the NATS broker. Default true.

influx_host.title: InfluxDB host (optional)
influx_host.description: Hostname for InfluxDB historical queries. Required only for the influx_query tool.

influx_db_name.title: InfluxDB database name (optional)
influx_db_name.description: Database to query. Defaults to tsdata if blank.
